title: Life of a DNS query comic
author: Julia Evans
license: unknown; no reuse license observed on page
reading_path: First three panels establish user/browser/cache; then successive wide panels show root, .com and domain-authority exchanges.
merit: Numbered comic panels alternate dialogue and precise records. Nameserver colors carry identity across distant rows, and the assumed empty cache is stated where the flow branches.
reference_preview_method: Original raster flattened onto white with aspect and complete content unchanged.
